audience: freelancers, contractors and small business owners who keep their accounts in FreeAgent

useCases.title: Find overdue sales invoices and who owes you
useCases.text: The AI lists sales invoices by status, optionally for one contact or project, and reads one with its due and paid values. You see which clients owe you money.

useCases.title: Check upcoming tax deadlines and amounts due
useCases.text: The AI reads the tax timeline: VAT returns, corporation tax, self assessment and other deadlines, with the amounts due.

useCases.title: Review profit and loss and the balance sheet
useCases.text: The AI reads the profit and loss summary for a date range or accounting period, and the balance sheet as at a date. It explains the numbers in plain words.

useCases.title: Find bank transactions that still need explaining
useCases.text: The AI lists your bank, credit-card and PayPal accounts with balances, and the unexplained transactions of one account. You see what still needs reconciling.

useCases.title: Check unbilled time and draft an invoice
useCases.text: The AI lists logged time that is not yet invoiced and can create a sales invoice in draft status. Nothing is sent to the customer.

useCases.title: Log time on a project task
useCases.text: The AI finds the project task and logs a timeslip on it for the current user. You can edit or remove it later in FreeAgent.
